Part.name: Challenger 2 TES side module (ASPRO-HMT ERA)
Part.description: Challenger 2 Theatre Entry Standard (TES) side package: an outer ASPRO-HMT ERA layer, a passive composite core and a steel backplate. Dimensions and layers are our own estimates, not factory data. Scale X/Z from 0.5 to 8; Y is fixed thickness. Local +Y is the exterior.
